core_claim.quote: In the attention schema theory, awareness is part of the control machinery for attention.

source.citation: Graziano MSA, Webb TW. The attention schema theory: a mechanistic account of subjective awareness. Frontiers in Psychology 6:500, 2015

prediction.statement: The temporoparietal junction (where the temporal and parietal lobes meet), especially on the right, is a key part of the network that builds the model of attention, so its activity tracks awareness and the awareness-dependent control of attention.
